caption:
Mr Turtle dozed off upright on a long flight, his head dropped to one side, and he woke up barely able to turn his neck.

When your head flops to one side for a long time, your neck keeps working to hold it. Supporting your head with a travel pillow or the window can ease that load.

Hybi's in-flight neck care: use a travel pillow to support the sides, recline your seat a little, get up and walk when you're awake, and do a few slow neck turns.

Arm tingling, a bad headache or dizziness is worth checking first. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD chiropractors can help. Book online via the link in bio
